column4: Side Distance Warning

The HMI layer shall send a request to VehicleConfigManager to retrieve the Side_Distance_Warning PROXI configuration status. VehicleConfigManager shall communicate with VehicleConfigService to obtain and validate the configuration status. The retrieved configuration response shall be returned from VehicleConfigService to VehicleConfigManager and finally provided to the HMI layer for feature availability handling.

HMI receives the value as "Absent" via signal,
$Side_Distance_Warning$

Then HMI shall not display the Side Distance Warning and Chime Volume menu items in the Vehicle Settings menu, and the customer shall not be able to perform any setting.

When the customer chooses to set the Side Distance Warning setting to Off on the LTM or ETM, the HMI layer shall send the updated customer preference to CarPropertyManager via the Android Car API. The Vehicle HAL (VHAL) shall transmit the updated signal to the IPC/HW through the vehicle communication interface.

The HMI receives the value as Off via signal,
$TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.Sdw_Req$.

Then the HMI/LTM/ETM shall update the Side Distance Warning setting status to Off in the Vehicle Settings menu.

The signal shall be transmitted to IPC within the defined system response time.
